## What to do next

Fix the failing Jest test "metrics query embed > charts a grouped aggregate above its table" to resolve the underlying issue. Also, update the "Span errors in ci:master" monitor by increasing its threshold above 0 and consider adding a baseline comparison to reduce sensitivity.

## Why it alerted

The alert was triggered by a single Jest test failure. The monitor's configuration, with a zero threshold, meant any error span would fire an alert. This specific test had no prior failures in the last 7 days.
9 non-zero windows out of 291 in 24 h; each non-zero window had exactly 3 error spans, all above the threshold of 0.
9 of 291 five-minute windows had exactly 3 error spans each — all above threshold=0, showing recurrent small-count breaches.
A single Jest test failure triggered the alert
